Name LUMIO (Lunar Meteoroid Impact Observer)
Form factor CubeSat
Units or mass 12U
Status not launched, expected in 2027
Launcher not launched
Organization Politecnico di Milano
Institution University
Entity type Academic / Education
Headquarters Italy
Oneliner

Observation of meteoroid impacts on the dark side of the Moon to complement Earth based observations

Description

Observing meteoroid impact flashes on the lunar far side for science & exploration hazard assessment.

Circle over the far side of the Moon to detect bright impact flashes during the lunar night, mapping meteoroid bombardments as they occur.

Main objective: Observation of meteoroids impacts on the dark side of the Moon to complement Earth based observations Useful to refine models of lunar meteoroid environment and inform future lunar exploration missions.

Secondary objective: autonomous orbit determination based on optical observations of the Moon disk.

Status: as of May 2023:

  • Phase A completed successfully Phase B ongoing.
  • SRR completed in March 2023 PDR planned in October 2023.
